Kolkata Police Investigate Billboard Incident Outside Abhishek Banerjee's Office

Kolkata Police officials, including from the Fire Department, visited the office of Abhishek Banerjee in connection with a billboard incident. The police are preparing sketches as part of their investigation into the matter. They had previously summoned Abhishek Banerjee after Derek O'Brien failed to appear in relation to the billboard case.
